name: Kusunoki Minato
source:
Madoka's son, a boy attending the same academy with Mao.

They met through Chris's introduction and are one of the members who joined the Madam Club together.

He dyes his hair red and thinks it looks cool.

His personality doesn't mesh well with the protagonist's, and combined with his overbearing way of speaking, it's fair to say they aren't exactly on good terms.

[From the [url=https://www.empress-game.com/yukanmadam/]official website[/url]]
